#Code for plotting dual isotope maps for isotope ratios in N2O measured during N2O consumption by purified Stutzerimonas stutzeri nitrous oxide reductase (N2OR).

- The code in this markdown file is based on the R script Louisa wrote: isotopemapping_withlegend_9212026.R

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#Load packages
```{r load_packages}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)
library(egg)
library(grid)
library(here) #Used to create file paths relative to top-level directory.
```

#Import data
```{r input_data}
data <- read.csv(here("data/input/SI_N2OR_rxns_deltas.csv"),header = TRUE)
print(names(data))
```

#Figure S4a: Plot delta_18O vs delta_N
```{r 18O_Nbulk}
x_col <- "delta_N"
y_col <- "delta_18O"
print(x_col)
print(y_col)

data[[x_col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(data[[x_col]]))
data[[y_col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(data[[y_col]]))

plot_data <- data[!is.na(data[[x_col]]) & !is.na(data[[y_col]]), ]

p_18O_Nbulk <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]])) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  ggpmisc::stat_poly_eq(
    formula = y ~ x,
    aes(label = after_stat(paste0("italic(", eq.label,")"))),
    parse =TRUE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(bold(delta^15*N^bulk)),
    y = expression(bold(delta^18*O ~ "(‰)"))
  ) +
  theme_classic () +
  theme( 
    axis.title = element_text(size =18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size =18),
    panel.border = element_rect( color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth =1),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

print(p_18O_Nbulk)
ggsave (
  filename = here("graphs/isotopemaps/isotopemap_18O_Nbulk_92126.tiff"),
  plot =p_18O_Nbulk,
  width = 6, height = 4, units = "in",
  dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

#Figure S4a-d: Use this figure for publication
```{r Fig_S4}
fig <- egg::ggarrange(
  p_18O_Nbulk, p_18O_Nalpha,
  p_SP_Nbulk, p_SP_18O,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = 2,
  labels = c("(a)", "(b)", "(c)", "(d)")
)
print (fig)
ggsave(
  filename= here("graphs/isotopemaps/isotopemapping_allplots_92126.tiff"),
  plot = fig,
  width = 6, height = 6, units = "in",
  dpi = 1200, compression = "lzw"
)
```
